ingest.note: Pipecat pipelines move 16 kHz PCM mono frames through services by default. Audio is normalized at the transport ingress.

egress.note: TTS/realtime outputs are resampled to the pipeline rate before reaching the transport.

potholes.note: Pipecat transports (e.g. FastAPI websocket, Exotel, Twilio) decode μ-law to PCM at the edge. Verify the chosen transport handles your telephony codec; raw websocket transports may need a custom decoder.
Turn endpointing uses a VAD/endpointing service separate from STT. Mis-tuning it causes false barge-in or long pauses.

Self-hosted Pipecat typically runs a bot process per call. Killing the runner mid-call drops the caller: implement SIGTERM drain (stop spawning, finish calls, exit) and autoscale on concurrent calls, not CPU.

WebSocket telephony transports (Twilio/Exotel serializers) run no echo cancellation. Carrier or speakerphone echo of the bot's own TTS can false-trigger barge-in; enable an audio filter/AEC or gate VAD while the bot speaks.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Pipecat 1.0+ uses user_turn_strategies in LLMUserAggregatorParams. When the VAD detects user speech, an InterruptionFrame propagates through the pipeline, discarding pending output frames. The transport serializer handles provider-specific clearing.
interruption.code_hint: LLMUserAggregatorParams(vad_analyzer=SileroVADAnalyzer()) — interruption is automatic. TwilioFrameSerializer sends clear automatically.

hosted_option.name: pipecat-cloud
hosted_option.note: Pipecat Cloud (by Daily) runs hosted bot runners with managed scaling. Pilot-friendly; verify current region coverage and per-minute pricing before committing a regulated deployment.

deployment.self_host_notes: Open source; self-host as a bot runner on VMs or Fly machines, typically one bot process per call. You own process supervision, drain on SIGTERM, warm pools for VAD/provider connections, and frame-level tracing.
